title: A smooth-test identity between a density and a pushed-forward measure holds on Borel subsets of U
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ Lebesgue integrable on U, σ a (Borel) measure on ℝ^P, q : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ measurable and h : ℝ^P → ℝ σ-integrable. Assume ∫_U b(y)u(y)dy = ∫ b(q(x))h(x)dσ(x) for every C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) compactly supported b : ℝⁿ → ℝ with tsupport b ⊆ U. Then ∫_B u(y)dy = ∫_{q⁻¹(B)} h(x)dσ(x) for every measurable B ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (q : Euclid P → Euclid n) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → Measurable q → IntegrableOn u U → Integrable h σ → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y in U, b y * u y = ∫ x, b (q x) * h x ∂σ) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ U → ∫ y in B, u y = ∫ x in q ⁻¹' B, h x ∂σ
